title: Exercise 3: Match the Sentence Halves
instruction: Match the sentence beginnings (1–10) with the appropriate endings (A–J) to create complete, grammatically sound sentences.

questions.half_a: While Dr. Dang Thuy Tram was recording her wartime thoughts in her diary,
Steve Jobs was working relentlessly on the first Macintosh computer
The archaeological team discovered ancient military artifacts
When the young inventor heard that his design won the grand prize,
While the resistance soldiers were enduring harsh conditions in the mountains,
The visionary animator was sketching preliminary storyboards
General Vo Nguyen Giap devised revolutionary tactics to carry out attacks
While the newly married couple were traveling across Southeast Asia,
The medical researchers made an impressive scientific breakthrough
When the historical documentary ended on television last night,
